SELECT T1."XCL_038", T1."XCL_039", T1."XCL_041"
FROM drivers AS T1
INNER JOIN qualifying AS T2 ON T1."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_058"
INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T2."XCL_057" = T3."XCL_065"
WHERE T3."XCL_065" = 841
  AND T1."XCL_041" = 'German'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_040") BETWEEN '1980' AND '1985'
  AND T2."XCL_064" IS NULL
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM results AS T4 WHERE T4."XCL_075" = T1."XCL_034" AND T4."XCL_089" IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY (SELECT MAX(CAST(T5."XCL_089" AS REAL)) FROM results AS T5 WHERE T5."XCL_075" = T1."XCL_034") DESC
LIMIT 1

JOIN results r ON d.XCL_034 = r.XCL_075

  AND q.XCL_057 = 841
  AND q.XCL_060 = 1
  AND r.XCL_082 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY r.XCL_082 DESC
LIMIT 1
